court: In the High Court of Madras†
judges_raw: (Before A.P. Sahi, C.J. and Subramonium Prasad, J.)
respondents: Union of India, Rep. by its Secretary and Others .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. Arul Vadivel Alias Sekar
For Respondent No. 3: Mr. R. Subramanian
prayer: PRAYER: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying for a Writ of Declaration, declaring the Negotiable Instrument (Amendment) Second Ordinance 2015, Ordinance No. 7 of 2015 dated 22.09.2015 as illegal and unconstitutional.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

A.P. Sahi, C.J.:— Learned Counsel for the parties do not dispute the position that the relevant enactment has already been legislated and therefore, the challenge raised to the proposed amendment under the Negotiable Instruments Act has become infructuous.

2. The Writ Petition is, accordingly, consigned to records without prejudice to the rights of the parties to contest the proceedings in an appropriate petition. However, there shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
